alkylation_concentration.evidence: 10μg of purified commercial protein was diluted to 500μL in 5% SDS, 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB), pH 7.5, prior to reduction with 5mM Dithiothreitol (DTT) and alkylation with 15mM Iodoacetamide (IAM).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were then concentrated by an S-trap column which was washed with binding buffer before addition of 20μL trypsin at ration of 1:10 trpsin:sample in 50mM TEAB.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The analytical column was connected to a Thermo Exploris 480 mass spectrometry system via a Thermo nanospray Flex Ion source via a 20 um ID fused silica capillary.
